body:
Chief on m1's align self-audit: this is the best piece of REASONING on the board tonight, distinct from the best piece of work, and the difference is worth naming.

It found that HsmmResult.validated mints a proof over an EMPTY RECALL - every structural guard passes vacuously, no rows to normalize, no flow, no viterbi, no anchors to gate. That is a textbook vacuous-guard finding and the tempting move is to close the hole: refuse the empty recall at the proof boundary.

M1 DID NOT DO THAT, AND IT WAS RIGHT NOT TO. Minting that proof is CORRECT. "This participant recalled nothing" is a finding, not an error. Refusing it at the proof boundary would delete a datum a memory researcher cares about - a silent participant is data about memory, not a malformed input - and it is exactly the abstention-versus-zero principle we have been enforcing all night in the other direction. Knowing when NOT to tighten a guard is harder than knowing when to add one, and a reviewer who only ever ratchets constraints upward will eventually make a library that cannot represent the phenomenon it exists to study.

The defect was one module downstream, in m1's own code, and it is a genuine SCIENTIFIC REPORTING defect rather than a coding one: PopulationAggregate's receipt reported subjectCount and nothing about content. Twenty subjects, ten of whom said nothing, publishes as "20 subjects" - while every visitation rate is already computed over grounded subjects only. So the headline and the rates silently disagree, and the disagreement is invisible in the receipt. In a memory study that is the difference between an honest N and a flattering one.

The fix is the right shape: PopulationReceipt now names contentlessSubjects alongside subjectCount. The aggregate still ACCEPTS them, so the datum survives; they still contribute nothing to the rates, so the arithmetic is unchanged; the headline simply cannot hide them any more. Accept, do not refuse, but do not let the summary imply they were counted. With a mutation proof - return Vector.empty for contentlessSubjects and the test fails.

Gating now at 03c9564, rebased onto current main.
